title: Three Handles And Streamlined Rescue Can
description: One independently authored complete streamlined rescue-can-inspired static decorative exterior. A full long blunt-ended three-dimensional can body has an oval barrel and finite flattened underside. Three complete thick closed-section handles form two long outer side air fields and one broad returned rear air field; all six full ends are positively rooted into the body. One whole continuous fixed tow-line-like element joins the front body to one whole open flat shoulder-loop-like strap resting on the same datum. Six closed whole meshes, four opaque constant PBR roles, metre-style native Z up and horizontal bounds-centred finite-ground display pose. All axial stations, cross sections, handle paths, complete line and strap topology are newly authored. Not a flattened or stretched two-lobed pull buoy, pierced kickboard with extra holes, annular life ring with removed centre, or extracted rope pieces. One full new model and zero scenes; repeated handles are not additional models. Dry empty stylized exterior only, no internal air/foam construction, waterproofing, buoyancy, flotation, strength, suitability, emergency use, carrying capacity, training, rescue procedure, certification, medical or safety performance claim. No person, victim or water. No product branding, manufacturing specification, text, logo, texture, rig, movement or interaction.
